description:
Board Game in Space!
Collect cards, unlock special dice, and battle your way to fame!

Still in Beta, can be quite buggy!

Screenshots:

Spoiler

Safe to add or remove mid-campaign!and should be compatible with all other mods.

Cosmicon Dice is a turn-based dice battle game, cloning the minigame of the same name from Honkai: Star Rail.
Talk to weeb looking NPC to play (in-game tutorial available)

Basic Gameplay:

Each player has a character card with specific dice pool, HP, ATK/DEF Levels, and abilities.
Each turn, select number of dice equal to your ATK/DEF Level
Attack - Defense = Damage dealt to defender.
Switch roles and repeat until one player's HP is depleted.
A myrid of abilities, special dice effects, and weather effects may modify the outcome.

Casino Mod Collab
If the Interastral Peace Casino mod is also loaded, you can spend stargems at the casino to challenge a strong opponent and unlock tournament mode for big rewards!

Changelog:

Spoiler
17/06/2026 - v0.3.0
- New content: 7 basic characters that comes with Easy Mode as default starting point and equippable bonuses.
- New Sound effects audio system synced to animation.
- Improved Battle UI with new damage animation, base+bonus dice values breakdown, visual highlights on tutorial interactables.
- Harmonize terminology, NPC display strings and CN localization overhaul.
- Massively optimized AI reroll strategy and performance.
- Tournament opponents alternate basic and advanced characters for fairer brackets.
- Rebalanced credit rewards to give less by default (easy mode) and more on harder settings.
- A ton of bug fixes.

20/05/2026 - v0.2.0
- Changed entry point from bars to comms (Custom NPCs generated for playing against).
- Fixed removal safety (0.1.0 if removed bricks save, update to 0.2.0 then it can be removed).
- Added a language switching script to toggle between CN and EN.

10/05/2026 - v0.1.0: First Release

discordPostHtml:
Dice Game in Space!

Play Gwent dice, collect cards, unlock special dice, and battle your way to fame!

Cosmicon Dice is a turn-based dice battle game, cloning the minigame of the same name from Honkai: Star Rail.
Find weeb looking NPCs in any markets' comms to play (first game launches tutorial automatically)

Basic Gameplay:
Each player has a character card with specific dice pool, HP, ATK/DEF Levels, and abilities.
Each turn, select number of dice equal to your ATK/DEF Level
Attack - Defense = Damage dealt to defender.
Switch roles and repeat until one player's HP is depleted.
A myrid of abilities, special dice effects, and weather effects may modify the outcome.

Casino Mod Collab: https://discord.com/channels/187635036525166592/1471961963063148656
If the Interastral Peace Casino mod is also loaded, you can spend stargems at the casino to challenge a strong opponent and unlock a tournament mode for big rewards.

Should be compatible with everything and safe to save mid game. NOT safe to remove.

Download: https://github.com/zman406986/Cosmicon/releases/download/v0.3.0/Cosmicon.Dice.zip
Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35382.0
Fossic Forum Thread (for CN ver.): https://www.fossic.org/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=19762

Github:https://github.com/zman406986/Cosmicon
